shell_commands:
cat > /tmp/fix_lines.txt << 'EOF'
L180 -> L158 (with resume absent)
L412 -> L390 (with resume off)
L196 -> L174 (with resume on, answers the owner)
L262 -> L240 (keeps the credentials of the socket)
L281 -> L259 (gives a session back)
L301 -> L279 (tells onConnect)
L364 -> L342 (replays an entry whose turn)
L328 -> L306 (replays a suppressed entry)
L351 -> L329 (replays an answer suppressed)
L213 -> L191 (answers another user naming the id)
L227 -> L205 (answers a never-issued id)
L240 -> L218 (never adopts a requested id)
L313 -> L291 (resumes the id its store knows)
L378 -> L356 (keeps a resumed session)
L253 -> L231 (still calls onDisconnect)
L428 -> L406 (with latest on, rejoins)
L445 -> L423 (with latest on, starts a new)
L460 -> L438 (with latest on, still rejoins)
L472 -> L450 (starts a new session when)
L496 -> L474 (with resume on but latest off)
L519 -> L497 (tells the owner of a session that aged out)
L535 -> L513 (answers another user naming an expired id)
L548 -> L526 (sends no resumeFailure at all)
L559 -> L537 (reads a named id with one call)
L420 -> L398 (still types a connected frame)
EOF
cat /tmp/fix_lines.txt

sed -i \
  's/#L180)/#L158)/g; s/#L412)/#L390)/g; s/#L196)/#L174)/g; s/#L262)/#L240)/g; s/#L281)/#L259)/g; s/#L301)/#L279)/g' \
  specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md && \
sed -i \
  's/#L364)/#L342)/g; s/#L328)/#L306)/g; s/#L351)/#L329)/g; s/#L213)/#L191)/g; s/#L227)/#L205)/g; s/#L240)/#L218)/g' \
  specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md && \
sed -i \
  's/#L313)/#L291)/g; s/#L378)/#L356)/g; s/#L253)/#L231)/g; s/#L428)/#L406)/g; s/#L445)/#L423)/g; s/#L460)/#L438)/g' \
  specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md && \
sed -i \
  's/#L472)/#L450)/g; s/#L496)/#L474)/g; s/#L519)/#L497)/g; s/#L535)/#L513)/g; s/#L548)/#L526)/g; s/#L559)/#L537)/g; s/#L420)/#L398)/g' \
  specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md && \
echo "Fixed line references"
grep -n "keeps the credentials of the socket that resumed a session" src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
grep "keeps the credentials of the socket that resumed a session" specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md
grep "never adopts a requested id" specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md
npx eslint src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1 && echo "✓ ESLint passed"

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: resolve typecheck and spec link errors

- Add missing `eventually` import to sessionResume.test.ts
- Fix type narrowing in validation.ts by asserting types after validation
- Update spec.md line number references in hal-engine-session-resume to reflect test location shifts caused by utility refactoring
EOF
)"
git push origin HEAD && git status
npm run spec:names 2>&1 && echo "✓ Spec names check passed"
npm run check:spec-links 2>&1 && echo "✓ Spec links check passed"

git add specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m "fix(specs): correct line number references for list_sessions tests in websocket protocol spec

Repoint citations to match the actual test locations after refactoring."
git push origin HEAD && git status
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint src/transport/ specs/ && npm run spec:names && npm run check:spec-links && echo "✓ All checks passed"
